body:
Tested using the GDQuest TPS demo. I ran it in both Mobile and Forward+ to check for obvious visual regressions and I profiled a dev build. Since the optimization here is the number of times GPU driver code is called, the optimization level shouldn't make a differnece. 

I observed a reproducible 5-10% improvement in the `end_frame()` function. Out of a 1 second profile, that is 70 ms -> 60-65ms. Which would correspond to a 1% overall improvement in CPU time. 

On an optimized build that percentage would be a little higher since the driver code isn't affected by optimizations. But overall the expected improvement would be about 0.1 mspf.

In any rate, its still an optimization worth doing and it might have more of an impact on devices where the drivers are quite slow (i.e. mobile devices)
